page.notes: Large initials R and S are decorative and read as the first letters of "Raia" and "Saccharum". The entry "R[?]nes cur cibis abdicandi": the word after R is unclear, possibly "Ranes". "Salivires": the letters after "Sal" are unclear. "Sal venem proritat": the word is unclear and may be "promitat". "Sal vino inspe[?]sus": the middle of the word is unclear. Ampersand in "quibus non" is printed as an Et-sign. The catchword "Scarus" is at the bottom right.
